LIPSA MAJHI

Lipsamona094@gmail.com | +91 7008193755 / 8328885803 | Bangalore, India

Professional Summary

Business Analyst with 6 years of experience across Banking, Asset Management, and SaaS domains, specializing in data governance, data quality management, business analysis, and data analytics. Proven expertise in defining DQ frameworks, data controls, and compliance processes, alongside delivering Power BI dashboards, SQL-based insights, and workflow automation. Adept at bridging business and technology through strong stakeholder engagement, Agile delivery, and cross-functional collaboration.

Core Competencies

Business Analysis & Documentation: BRD, FSD, User Stories, TTI Mapping, Use Case Modeling • Data Governance & Quality: DQ Dimensions Collection, Control Definition, Control Mapping, Compliance Reporting

Data Analytics & Reporting: Power BI, Excel Dashboarding, Storytelling with Data SQL & ETL: Joins, Aggregates, CTEs, Window Functions, Data Profiling & Validation • • Project Delivery: Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Waterfall, Sprint Planning, Backlog Grooming, UAT • Product Management: Roadmaps, Feature Prioritization, Release Planning, MVP Delivery • • Process Optimization: Workflow Automation, Business Process Re-engineering (BPR) • Testing & Support: Functional/Regression Testing, UAT Coordination, Issue Triage Stakeholder Engagement: Requirements Gathering, Product Demos, Executive Presentations

Technical Skills

Tools: JIRA, Confluence, MS Visio, Draw.io, Excel (Advanced), PowerPoint • BI & Visualization: Power BI (DAX, Custom Visuals), Tableau • Databases: MySQL • Documentation: BRD, FSD, UML Diagrams, Wireframes, BPMN • Platforms: Web Applications, SaaS Products, Data Warehousing, Reporting Dashboards

Professional Experience



Senior Consultant – EY | Dec 2025 – Present Led data strategy assessment initiatives by collecting stakeholder inputs and documenting current- and future-state recommendations in Confluence.

Conducted data quality, data governance, and data readiness assessments for analytics and AI initiatives. • Analyzed data ownership, stewardship models, metadata, and control frameworks aligned to governance standards.

Created and tracked user stories, epics, tasks, and defects in Jira ensuring delivery traceability. • Collaborated with Data Engineering, Analytics, Product, and Architecture teams to validate data lineage and transformations.

Defined data quality rules, KPIs, and remediation workflows for critical business data. • Supported stakeholder workshops, validations, and business sign-offs. • Prepared assessment reports, maturity models, current/future-state diagrams, and executive presentations.

• Ensured alignment with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and EY methodologies.

Senior Business Analyst

HTC Global Services | Bangalore | Sep 2023 – Oct 2024

Client-Society General

Gathered and translated business requirements into functional specifications and wireframes for digital



platform upgrades. Led documentation efforts including BRDs, FSDs, and TTI (Traceability) matrices for regulatory and internal audit requirements.

Developed SQL queries for deep-dive data validation, profiling, and ad hoc reporting. • Designed self-service Power BI dashboards, automating KPIs and reducing reporting TAT by 70%. • Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives) and managed Jira tickets for epics/user stories.

Managed cross-functional teams (QA, Dev, Ops) during UAT and production issue resolution cycles. • • Supported post-production monitoring, RCA, and implementation of corrective action plans. Led Data Governance initiatives, including Data Quality (DQ) dimensions collection, control definition, and control mapping for compliance and audit readiness.

Collaborated with Data Stewards and business stakeholders to embed DQ checkpoints into workflows, improving reconciliation accuracy and reducing data quality issues.

Business Analyst

Standard Chartered | Bangalore | Apr 2021 – Aug 2023

Partnered with Product Owners and business stakeholders to define user journeys and convert them into actionable product backlogs.

Created interactive wireframes using Balsamiq and Visio for approval workflows and loan servicing modules.

Delivered high-impact Power BI dashboards used by senior leadership for portfolio management and SLA tracking. Executed UAT cycles, coordinated testing across multiple teams, and validated data using SQL extracts. • • Prioritized product features using Moscow technique and maintained roadmap alignment with business

goals.

Collaborated with developers to resolve blockers, clarify requirements, and ensure adherence to SLAs. Identified process bottlenecks and proposed automation strategies using macros and system triggers. •

Business Research Analyst

Service 1st BPM Pvt Ltd (Formerly Usource Data LLP) | Bangalore | Jan 2019 – Jan 2021

Conducted market research and business requirement elicitation sessions for clients. • Drafted BRDs and user stories for client-facing applications and internal data tools. • Built analytical reports using Excel (pivot tables, charts) and generated insights from customer segmentation.

• Participated in joint application development (JAD) sessions with clients and developers to finalize

workflows.

• Played a key role in QA by validating system behavior, logging bugs, and supporting test cycles.

Customer Support Executive (Digital Officer – Axis Bank) | May 2018 – Dec 2018

Handled outbound cold calling and customer onboarding for Axis Bank digital products. • Provided customer support, follow-ups, and issue resolution. • Performed quality analysis and coordinated with stakeholders for escalations.

Education & Certifications

MBA (HR & Marketing) – College of IT & Management Education, Bhubaneswar

Key Projects & Achievements

Data Governance Enablement: Implemented DQ framework by defining dimensions, mapping controls, and embedding quality rules into reporting workflows, reducing reconciliation errors by 40%.

Automated Business Workflows: Designed rule-based automation that improved data entry accuracy and reduced manual intervention by 60%.

Power BI Real-Time Dashboard: Delivered cross-domain dashboards integrating data from SQL Server, increasing visibility across departments.

Agile Process Champion: Led agile transition efforts, establishing best practices and improving sprint



delivery metrics by 30%. Stakeholder Recognition: Earned multiple appreciations for timely delivery, detailed documentation, and proactive production support.
